title: Read completion across delivery environments
when: A done item has member runs in several environments
need: Shipping rows preserve each run's QA disposition and name the environment that completed the item. A successful member run can read live after the item completed elsewhere; an executing run is still deploying. Failed QA and removed rows retain their diagnostics. The item page shows completion only on the completion run, never on Also in rows.
surface: Shipping card and item page Delivery panel
review: Focused DOM regressions cover done, pending and other-environment outcomes; production observation remains owed.
